title: Big Bugs? BANNED 🚫
excerpt: One of our fastest releases yet, packed with major bug fixes, Block History, improved Block Mode, better Mutual Mode protection, Dark Mode improvements, and more.
body:
This update is one of our fastest releases yet! We fixed a huge number of bugs, introduced a better Block History system, improved Block Mode and Mutual Mode, and made Friends Remover smoother and more reliable overall.

And to celebrate this update, BLOCK MODE is available for everyone for a LIMITED TIME!!! Seal your blocks in before it's too late.

added.moreInfo: Added a dedicated history system for users you have blocked.
Added an unblock button that allows users to quickly unblock users from Block History.
Friends are now cached with their friend-since date for faster and more reliable access.

added.text: Custom Unfriend History and Settings Icons
added.moreInfo: Added custom icons for both the Unfriend History and Settings buttons in the popup, replacing the old emoji icons.
Block Mode is temporarily available for free to all users for a limited time. Get your blocks in before the offer ends!

Added error-log detection to the uninstall system. When users provide a reason for uninstalling Friends Remover, relevant errors encountered by the extension can be collected to help identify and fix issues.
Updated the Mutual Friends removal screen and added friend-count information to better display the size of the removal.

removed.moreInfo: Block Mode is no longer restricted to FR+ users.
Removed the broken RoCaptcha verification system from Settings.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed Block Mode completely not working because the wrong Roblox API was being used.
Fixed dismissed users sometimes not showing the correct check mark.
Fixed several systems not respecting the 'Receive Notifications' setting.
Fixed headshots sometimes failing to load correctly after switching the popup view.

fixed.text: Pinned and Trusted Users in Mutual Mode
fixed.moreInfo: Fixed pinned and trusted users being able to get removed through Mutual Mode.
Fixed the Compact Viewer removal button not updating to 'Remove (count)' when Mutual Mode was enabled.
Fixed multiple issues causing the popup to become laggy.
Fixed headshots flashing on the removal screen.
Fixed searching in Compact View sometimes causing the 'No Friends Found' error.
Fixed the 'Switched to Friends List' toast appearing too high.

improved.moreInfo: Made the popup loading screen more descriptive so users can better understand what Friends Remover is doing.
The popup button used to change the view type now displays an icon corresponding with the currently selected view.
Fixed Block Mode losing its permanent blue theme and ensured the blue theme remains consistent.
Block Mode now appears before Mutual Mode when selecting a removal type.
Added Dark Mode support to all error messages.
Fixed certain text becoming difficult to read when Dark Mode is enabled.
Improved the Mutual Friends removal screen and added the current friend count to the removal information.
Improved Block Mode history with dedicated history entries and direct unblock controls.
